items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser that won't strip skin that already looks dry.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a comfortable, hydrated-looking skin barrier.
Tinted mineral sunscreen with iron oxides helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening and suits deeper skin tones without a white cast.

response.routine_note: A mole on your cheek that has grown and darkened over the year should be checked by a dermatologist soon, before you add any brightening products, and nothing we sell is meant for that. Until then, keep to a gentle cleanse, moisturizer and a tinted SPF every morning, reapplying if you're outdoors.
